law: Use the Contact Provider framework if your app manages its own contacts to make them available in other apps that use the framework.
This enables people to organize the contacts they use in your app separately from their personal contacts.
Use the manager to enable or disable the extension domain, typically using the default domain.
After enabling the extension domain, the extension can run and sync contacts, making contacts available to other apps that use the framework.
Xcode provides a Contact Provider extension template for use in an existing project to add Contact Provider support.
